# Pavlicevits Colors — llms.txt

> Pavlicevits Colors is a specialized paint store in Kalamaria, Thessaloniki, Greece, founded in 1990 with trade roots dating to 1982. The store operates across four product categories: architectural/decorative paints, automotive refinish paints, marine paints, and special applications (industrial floors, pools, custom color formulation). It maintains an official partnership with Pellachrom (a Northern-Greek paint manufacturer based in Edessa) and stocks Vivechrom, Vechro, Kraft Paints, Vitex, and other major Greek and international brands. The store serves Northern Greece with particular strength in the Halkidiki hospitality and marine sectors (Sani, Porto Carras marinas), and in Kalamaria/east-Thessaloniki residential renovations. Two generations of the same family work the counter.

## Brand essence
- Slogan: "Making Your Life Colorful"
- Brand color: Petrol (#0F4C5C)
- Voice: precise, warm, technical without being patronizing, Greek-language-first
- Positioning: technical breadth + craftsmanship + custom color science + curated material quality
